title: Admin - Comment Moderation - Handle Vendor Flagged Content - Functional Test Plan
overview: Functional testing of the Admin Comment Moderation - Handle Vendor Flagged Content feature on the Y4J platform. This feature allows Admins to review vendor-flagged reviews, see the vendor's flag reason, take action (approve or reject), and trigger vendor notifications after the decision. Covers flag reason display, status marking, admin actions, notification triggering, and dispute resolution flow.

testCases.title: Vendor flag reason is displayed clearly on the card
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. A vendor-flagged review exists in the moderation queue.
steps: Find a card with 'Vendor Flagged' status
Observe the flag reason section on the card
expectedResults: The vendor's flag reason is displayed clearly on the card
The reason text explains why the vendor flagged the review
The reason is labeled as coming from the vendor (e.g., 'Vendor Flag Reason:')
The reason is readable and not truncated
testCases.postconditions: Vendor flag reason is confirmed visible and clear

testCases.title: Content is marked 'Vendor Flagged' status
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. A vendor has flagged a review.
expectedResults: The flagged content shows 'Vendor Flagged' status badge
The badge is visually distinct from other statuses
The status indicates the vendor has disputed this review
The item appears when filtering by 'Pending' status
testCases.postconditions: Vendor Flagged status is confirmed displayed

testCases.title: Admin can approve vendor-flagged review
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. A vendor-flagged review exists.
steps: Find a card with 'Vendor Flagged' status
expectedResults: An 'Approve' action is available on vendor-flagged cards
Clicking Approve changes the status to 'Approved'
The review remains visible to users (vendor's flag is overruled)
A success notification may be displayed
The admin's decision is final
testCases.postconditions: Vendor-flagged review is approved and visible to users

testCases.title: Admin can reject vendor-flagged review
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. A vendor-flagged review exists.
steps: Find a card with 'Vendor Flagged' status
expectedResults: A 'Reject' action is available on vendor-flagged cards
Clicking Reject changes the status to 'Rejected'
The review is removed/hidden from users (vendor's flag is upheld)
A success notification may be displayed
The admin's decision is final
testCases.postconditions: Vendor-flagged review is rejected and hidden from users

testCases.title: Vendor notification is triggered after approval
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. A vendor-flagged review has been approved.
steps: Observe if a notification is triggered to the vendor
expectedResults: After approval, a notification is sent to the vendor
The notification informs the vendor that their flag was reviewed and the review was approved (kept visible)
The notification is triggered automatically after the admin decision
OR the system logs the notification for delivery
testCases.postconditions: Vendor is notified of the approval decision

testCases.title: Vendor notification is triggered after rejection
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. A vendor-flagged review has been rejected.
steps: Observe if a notification is triggered to the vendor
expectedResults: After rejection, a notification is sent to the vendor
The notification informs the vendor that their flag was reviewed and the review was rejected (removed)
The notification is triggered automatically after the admin decision
OR the system logs the notification for delivery
testCases.postconditions: Vendor is notified of the rejection decision

testCases.title: Vendor-flagged items appear in Pending filter
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. Vendor-flagged items exist.
expectedResults: Vendor-flagged items appear in the Pending filter results
They show 'Vendor Flagged' status badge
They are grouped with other pending items
The vendor flag reason is visible on these cards
testCases.postconditions: Vendor-flagged items are accessible via Pending filter

testCases.title: Flag reason provides enough context for admin decision
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. A vendor-flagged item with a detailed reason exists.
steps: Read the flag reason alongside the review content
expectedResults: The flag reason is displayed alongside the original review content
The admin can see both the review and the vendor's objection
This provides enough context to make a fair decision
Both the review text and flag reason are fully readable
testCases.postconditions: Sufficient context is available for admin decision

testCases.title: Vendor-flagged card shows the original review content
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. A vendor-flagged review exists.
steps: Observe the content text on the card
expectedResults: The original review content is displayed on the card
The content is the user's review (not the vendor's flag reason)
The admin can read what the user wrote
The content is not modified or censored before admin review
testCases.postconditions: Original review content is visible for admin review

testCases.title: Multiple vendor-flagged items can be processed independently
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. Multiple vendor-flagged items exist.
expectedResults: Each vendor-flagged item can be processed independently
Approving one does not affect others
Rejecting one does not affect others
Each decision is recorded separately
Notifications are sent for each decision independently
testCases.postconditions: Independent processing of multiple flags is confirmed
